title: Grateful Dead Live at Woodstock Music on 1969-08-16
lineage: Panasonic SV-3700 > Cardas cable S/PDIF > Edirol UA-5 > analog out > Korg MR-1 DFF @ [1bit/2.8 mhz] Rate Conversion: AudioGate to [24bit/96 khz] Mastering: In WaveLab with L3 Waves Multimaximizer > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of Woodstock’s August 16 1969 set captures a historic but uneven performance – highlighted by an epic 45‑minute “Turn On Your Lovelight” amid generally mixed musical quality.
ai_review.review: The FLAC24 soundboard source provides decent clarity for a vintage tape, though listeners are advised to use EQ. Musically the show is considered a historical curiosity rather than a peak Dead performance; Pigpen’s marathon “Turn On Your Lovelight” stands out while “High Time” is viewed as a drag, and overall many reviewers find the set less compelling than other 1969 dates.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is judged average to below‑average by several reviewers, but the soundboard source offers good technical fidelity; the weighted blend yields a modest rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear for an old tape; reviewers suggest using EQ to compensate for age‑related coloration, no major dropouts reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long second‑set jam with a 45‑minute Lovelight dominates; pacing feels uneven and the overall performance is seen as weaker than other ’69 shows.
